verdict.rationale: Oyster's docs show that submitting an EOR employment triggers contract generation (oyster-docs-9), and that verified agreements are sent out for signature (oyster-docs-11). Contractor contracts can also be generated instantly (oyster-docs-19). So e-signature exists for employment agreements, but only as part of Oyster's own onboarding flow. missing for 10: sending arbitrary offer letters or other HR documents for e-signature, per-employee document storage or retrieval, details of the signing experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.
